docs: Content of the Others page. Each section is a folder in the tree; add an item to a section's list and it shows up on the page, with no code to change. href is relative to the site root. A new section is a new object in seccoes. unidade: singular and plural for the count beside the title.

seccoes.texto: What I'm building for my daughter, to keep.

itens.texto: Her page: the time since she was born, always counting.

seccoes.texto: Small games I make for her, to play on a phone or tablet.

itens.texto: Shy fish swim to a lullaby. Touch the screen and they hide and the music stops; wait calmly and they come back one by one, bringing the music with them.
